content: ASIL for AUTOSAR elements (optional) All AUTOSAR ele- ments should receive an ASIL attribute, if at least one safety requirement is allocated to it. The ASIL shall be added as Sdg data with gid=SAFEX to the AdminData sec- tion in XML. The XML contents shall contain an Sd element with attribute gid=ASIL , valid values are the same as in [TPS_SAFEX_00201].
